data.one_liner: Send pageviews and custom events to Plausible Analytics
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin for Plausible Analytics that uses the events API to send click events, pageviews, and custom goals. It supports optional revenue tracking, custom properties, and includes a navigator observer to automatically track screen transitions.
use_when: You want to integrate Plausible Analytics into a Flutter application
You need privacy-friendly analytics tracking with custom properties and revenue
avoid_when: You are using a different analytics backend like Firebase or Sentry
strengths: Includes a NavigatorObserver for automatic pageview tracking
Supports custom properties, revenue tracking, and non-interactive events
data.setup_notes: Android release mode requires the internet permission in the AndroidManifest.xml.
